standard_prerequisites.use: The two points u, u' of U over x.

core_obligations: Reduce U affine etale over X; the fibre of the diagonal over (x, x) is the scheme fibre of U x_X U -> U x U over (u, u').
For u' -> u both over x, the induced map of scheme fibres is an isomorphism onto the diagonal component.
Closedness of the diagonal fibre follows from the corresponding scheme statement.
proof_roadmap: Presentation reduction; fibre identification; scheme closedness transfer.
difficulty_reason: A fibre-identification argument; the transfer is the substance.
